game_updates.title: PAYDAY 2 dropped the Native Linux version so you'll need to use Proton
game_updates.contents: OVERKILL / Starbreeze Entertainment announced that PAYDAY 2 has dropped support for their Native Linux version with a big update to the game with 64bit support. game_updates.title: Player Reports: Stuttering / FPS Drops
game_updates.contents: Player Reports: Stuttering / FPS DropsHey Geese (and Ducks)! Over the past few days, some Windows PC players have been experiencing sudden stuttering and FPS drops, particularly while moving their mouse. We've been digging into this nonstop, and after a lot of testing, we want to share what we've found. What's going on?First, the important part: this wasn't caused by a game update. Prior to today's v4.10 update, we were already receiving reports of this issue. The previous PC build had not been updated since May 20, when we released v4.09 with some role adjustments. We actually held back the release of v4.10 while we investigated these reports because we wanted to better understand what was happening before introducing a new update into the mix. Nothing was patched, added, or altered on ou...

game_updates.title: Subnautica 2 Experimental Branch Released
game_updates.contents: Hello Subnauts, As part of our ongoing dedication to the open development process during Early Access, we’re launching the Experimental branch of Subnautica 2 today on Steam. The Experimental branch is an entirely opt-in experience. It allows players to preview upcoming content for Subnautica 2 in an earlier state, and helps us catch any issues before we ship features to the main Early Access build. Experimental does often mean just that. The builds are more likely to contain bugs (potentially game-breaking), and we often caution that you not get attached to any saves while playing on this branch. Saves are also not compatible between versions. This means you can’t import or export saves between Experimental and the main branch. But don’t worry about accidentally loading your saves on the ...

game_updates.title: You can hug the Super Earth grunts in Helldivers 2's Devoid of Liberty update, which revamps NPC troops and adds new Illuminate enemies
game_updates.contents: The secret of the floating bear is revealed: Helldivers 2 is gearing up for an assault on the Void, that icky hellmouth gobbling up a chunk of Illuminate-controlled space. The co-op shooter’s big new update, Devoid of Liberty, sees the intergalactic nasties throwing out two new mutant enemies to fight on the field, while your bosses on Super Earth deploy better equipped, better trained, generally less all-round useless infantry troops to help you out.
